pr_metadata.title: fix(epics): fail org-wide vrg-queue and vrg-epic-audit clearly when <owner>/.github is missing
pr_metadata.summary: The org-wide paths of vrg-queue and vrg-epic-audit now check that <owner>/.github exists first and, when it does not, stop with a one-line message pointing at --repo instead of a raw GitHub API error.
pr_metadata.notes: New helper epics.require_org_home reuses github.repo_exists (and so is_repo_not_found) and the EpicHomeError / cli_main one-line handler from #3603. Other probe failures surface as EpicHomeError with the API error; a missing token keeps its own message. The --repo paths are unchanged and do not probe. Where a public repo with no owner .github should home its epics is left to vergil-project/.github#463. Tests cover existing, missing, other-error and missing-token cases in the helper and both CLIs.
